typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		ROOT_CLCL_ID as string,
		CCERT_LEAD_TYPE as string,
		SC_SCHEME as string,
		SC_SUBSCHEME as string,
		ITERATION as string,
		CLCL_ID as string,
		CM_TD_NOTIFY_FLG as string,
		MARKET as string,
		MISC_DATA as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT                     CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), C.sourceClaimId) AS CLCL_ID, 	CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), SUBSTRING(C.sourceClaimId, 1, 10)) AS ROOT_CLCL_ID, 	CONVERT(VARCHAR(200), C.leadType) AS CCERT_LEAD_TYPE, 	CONVERT(VARCHAR(25), C.scheme) AS SC_SCHEME, 	CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), C.subscheme) AS SC_SUBSCHEME,                   CONVERT(VARCHAR(255), C.sourceMarket) AS MARKET,                   CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), C.claimReviewIterationKey) AS ITERATION,                   CASE  WHEN C.isTechDenial = 1 THEN \'Y\' ELSE \'N\' END AS CM_TD_NOTIFY_FLG,                   CONVERT(VARCHAR(255), \'Workable caseId:\' + c.caseIdText) AS  MISC_DATA  FROM [Case].vwDrgCase C WHERE  C.caseStatusConfigId IN (40, 3456, 3457) /*40=open,2402=complete, 3456=mngrAppr, 3457=hbaAppr*/ AND DATEPART(HOUR, GETDATE()) BETWEEN  1 AND 7 /* run between 1am-7am */',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSourceTRKCasevwDrgCaseEXCLUDECOMPLETECASE
OLEDBSourceTRKCasevwDrgCaseEXCLUDECOMPLETECASE sink(input(
		ROOT_CLCL_ID as string,
		CCERT_LEAD_TYPE as string,
		SC_SCHEME as string,
		SC_SUBSCHEME as string,
		ITERATION as string,
		CLCL_ID as string,
		CM_TD_NOTIFY_FLG as string,
		MARKET as string,
		MISC_DATA as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	mapColumn(
		ROOT_CLCL_ID,
		CCERT_LEAD_TYPE,
		SC_SCHEME,
		SC_SUBSCHEME,
		ITERATION,
		CLCL_ID,
		CM_TD_NOTIFY_FLG,
		MARKET,
		MISC_DATA)) ~> OutputPlaceHolderOracleDestinationAGPBIDRSTGCLAIM
OLEDBSourceTRKCasevwDrgCaseEXCLUDECOMPLETECASE sink(input(
		SC_SUBSCHEME as string,
		ITERATION as string,
		CM_TD_NOTIFY_FLG as string,
		MISC_DATA as string,
		MARKET as string,
		ROOT_CLCL_ID as string,
		SC_SCHEME as string,
		CCERT_LEAD_TYPE as string,
		CLCL_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		SC_SUBSCHEME,
		ITERATION,
		CM_TD_NOTIFY_FLG,
		MISC_DATA,
		MARKET,
		ROOT_CLCL_ID,
		SC_SCHEME,
		CCERT_LEAD_TYPE,
		CLCL_ID)) ~> SqlDestinationTRKSTGCLAIMITERATION
